subject: FinLytics PoC — architecture review & migration scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael@finlytics.com>, Todd Williams <todd@edgeops.io>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: PoC architecture deep-dive and migration sequencing

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this PoC with us. We'd like to schedule an architecture deep-dive to align on migration sequencing — FinLytics is planning to migrate inference from our current managed endpoint and some self-hosted nodes to a hybrid Redwood Dedicated + Private setup. The goal for the session is to:

- Share our current infra: autoscaling, KV cache patterns, and persistence for KV cache.
- Discuss model variants, quantization tradeoffs, and compatibility with our current ONNX/ggml artifacts.
- Walk through a proposed timeline for data migration, traffic cutovers, and rollback plans.

Can we target a 90-minute slot early next week? Our prefered times (PST): Tue 12/1 10:00–11:30, Wed 12/2 09:30–11:00, or Thu 12/3 13:00–14:30. Attendees: Michael Chu (CTO), Elena Rojas (Platform Lead), and Todd Williams (vendor partner).

Please let me know who from Redwood should join and whether you want pre-reads.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rojas
Platform Lead, FinLytics
elena@finlytics.com

Attachment: finlytics-current-arch.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael@finlytics.com>, Todd Williams <todd@edgeops.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC architecture deep-dive and migration sequencing

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and glad FinLytics is moving forward. Rafael here (Solutions & Strategic Sales). We should plan for a 90-minute technical deep-dive — we'll bring the team who will own the migration and the runtime tuning. Proposed Redwood attendees: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer), Dev Patel (Runtime/Infra), and me.

Of your slots, Wed 12/2 09:30–11:00 PST works best for us. Tentative agenda:

1) 10 min intros & goals
2) 25 min FinLytics current infra and traffic profile
3) 35 min migration approach (staging, canary, KV/cache migration)
4) 20 min model compatibility & quantization strategy
5) 10 min next steps / action items

I'll add a short pre-read (attached) — redwood-poc-checklist.pdf — and a baseline costing worksheet so you have a sense of throughput costs (baseline-costing.xlsx). If you'd like deeper kernel/compilation detail, Dev can bring example traces.

If Wed is confirmed I'll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder.

Thanks,
Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (PDF, 64KB); baseline-costing.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC architecture deep-dive and migration sequencing

Adding a note for the agenda: please make sure we cover the following technical checkpoints so the PoC run gives us actionable metrics:

- KV cache warm-up strategy and how we measure miss rates during cutover
- Expected token distribution and batching profiles (we need sequence-length histograms)
- Model-variant compatibility (float16 -> int8/4bit quantization fallbacks)
- Network topology & egress controls for Private deployment (we should get their IP allow-list)

I'll prepare a 2-slide overview for the runtime optimization piece. Also attaching an internal sketch (network-topology.png).

-Marissa

Attachment: network-topology.png (PNG, 210KB)

From: Michael Chu <michael@finlytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Elena Rojas <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Todd Williams <todd@edgeops.io>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC architecture deep-dive and migration sequencing

Hi all — quick update: our CTO is unexpectedly out Tuesday and Wed morning due to a travel change. We still want the deep-dive but can you do Thu 12/3 13:00–14:30 PST or Mon 12/7 10:00–11:30 PST instead? If Thu works for Redwood, we can keep it to 90 minutes and have the same attendee list.

Apologies for the shuffle — we want Michael on the call for the migration gating decisions.

Thanks,
Michael

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef1234567890
Shared Drive pre-reads: https://redwood.app/drive/FinLytics/PoC-Checklist

Action items before Thu:
- FinLytics: share sequence-length histograms and peak RPS for the last 30 days (Elena)

I'll attach the checklist to the invite; if anything changes we'll adjust. Looking forward to the session.
